method.non_dictionary_cache_note: One Auchan response was gzip despite identity request; raw bytes retained and local text explicitly decompressed before reading. No nutritional/health advertising was adopted.
method.dictionary_pacing: After factual slot handover, waited2.2s and used exactly one serial direct-request helper with target2.15s intervals; no extra Dex web-tool opens. All99planned requests completed200.
method.whole_batch_walk: Inspected every selected sense/paradigm and all163oriented captions against actual endpoint descriptions and independently read fresh evidence; ingredient/material/botanical links do not themselves approve any generated puzzle.
method.compact_metadata: Repeated global rubric explanations, endpoint descriptions already present in the bound bundle/module, and duplicate form arrays omitted. Exact49item/163edge verdicts, source URLs, captions, required changes and fresh dictionary bindings retained unchanged.
